pages.text: An SCV builds the command center, supply depots, barracks, factory and starport, and stays to build.
Marines hold every terran camp: a campfire with a concrete pad, a forge and an antenna mast.
Siege tank: deploys into siege mode for long range.

Their base is a concrete square with turrets and bunkers. Under it lies a steel maze with labs and a reactor core. Above the clouds hangs the battlecruiser Hyperion. Terran buildings lift off and land.
